item.name: Lobby
item.purpose: The front entrance and waiting area where patients arrive before they are checked in.
item.whatYouDo: Watch arriving patients and keep the entrance clear, since patients can faint or even catch fire here before treatment begins.
item.accessNotes: Open to everyone; the first space players and patients pass through.
item.cardSummary: The hospital's front-of-house area. Nothing is treated here, but emergencies like a fainting or burning patient can begin at the door, so it is the first place to keep an eye on.

item.name: Check-In Room
item.purpose: The player's home base and reception desk, where patients are inspected and either admitted or rejected.
item.whatYouDo: Inspect each patient at the shutter and admit or reject them, watch the security cameras, and use the coffee station to restore sanity (a single coffee, then a roughly 180-second cooldown). Later shifts add gear such as a taser here.
item.accessNotes: Player spawn and command center; the cameras and coffee station live here.
item.cardSummary: The control hub of the whole shift. You vet patients, monitor the cameras, and top up sanity from this one room, which makes it the area you return to most often.

item.name: Staff Only Room
item.purpose: A restricted staff zone that holds the in-game shop.
item.whatYouDo: Buy gear and upgrades from the shop, whose stock is randomized and changes from shift to shift.
item.accessNotes: Staff only; the shop opens briefly around the start of each shift, so visit it early.
item.cardSummary: The hospital's shop, tucked behind a staff door. Its rotating stock and short opening window make it the place to grab upgrades before the night gets busy.

item.name: Medical Wing (Rooms 1-5)
item.purpose: The right-hand wing of five interchangeable rooms that handle standard patient care.
item.whatYouDo: Take an admitted patient to the nearest empty bed, run the DNA diagnosis to find what is wrong, and administer the matching treatment. Any of the five rooms works the same way.
item.accessNotes: Rooms 1 through 5; pick whichever bed is free.
item.cardSummary: The standard-care wing where most patients are treated. Because all five rooms are identical, they are grouped here as one area: diagnose, treat, and move to the next free bed.

item.name: Room 6 - X-Ray Room
item.purpose: The left-wing X-Ray room, the first of the three skill-based treatment rooms.
item.whatYouDo: Play a memory minigame: a sequence of colors or squares flashes, and you copy it back in the same order to complete the X-Ray.
item.accessNotes: Part of the left-wing emergency rooms; used for patients routed to X-Ray.
item.cardSummary: A treatment room built around a copy-the-sequence memory test. Watch the flashed order, repeat it correctly, and the X-Ray is done.

item.name: Room 7 - Heart Monitor Room
item.purpose: The left-wing heart monitor room, a reaction-based treatment room.
item.whatYouDo: Play a clicking minigame: hit the white icons to push progress toward 100 percent while avoiding the red skull buttons, which reduce your progress.
item.accessNotes: Part of the left-wing emergency rooms; used for patients routed to the heart monitor.
item.cardSummary: A fast clicking room where you race to 100 percent. The catch is the red skulls mixed into the targets, so accuracy matters as much as speed.

item.name: Room 8 - Surgery Room
item.purpose: The left-wing surgery room, the most time-pressured treatment room.
item.whatYouDo: Play a timed item-delivery minigame: after you administer the IV Drop the timer starts, and you fetch and hand over the requested surgical tools across several rounds, each round on about a 45-second clock.
item.accessNotes: Part of the left-wing emergency rooms; the toughest of the three minigame rooms.
item.cardSummary: The hospital's high-pressure surgery room. Once the IV Drop starts the clock, you have roughly 45 seconds per round to deliver the right tools, making it the area new players misjudge most often.
